L10: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
L10: Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
L10: Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
L10: Mode fault / collision detection.
L10: All clock polarity/phase combinations.
L10: MSB-first vs LSB-first byte ordering.
L10: Bidirectional mode (single data pin).
L10: Receive overrun (flag-serviced-too-late).
L10: Baud rate divisor sweep.
L10: Wait/Stop mode behavior.
L10: EoTp Short Packet (DT=0x08, payload=0x0F0F, ECC=0x01, VC=0) — verify HS detection regardless of HS/LP transmission; veri
L10: EoTp enable/disable interoperability with DSI v1.0 peripherals.
L10: Short Packet decode: DI + Data0 + Data1 + ECC = 4 bytes; verify all processor-sourced and peripheral-sourced Data Types.
L10: Long Packet decode: 6..65541 bytes; DI + WC + ECC + payload + 2-byte Checksum.
L10: Header ECC: Hamming-modified (24,8); verify single-bit correction + 2-bit detection; verify P6 and P7 = 0.
L10: Annex B Long Packet Checksum test vectors: gpcTestData0 → 0x0F87; gpcTestData1 → 0x1E0E; gpcTestData2 → 0xE569; gpcTestD
L10: Zero-payload Long Packet Footer = 0xFFFF; non-checksum-peripheral Footer = 0x0000.
L10: Video Mode Non-Burst with Sync Pulses (§8.11.2).
L10: Video Mode Non-Burst with Sync Events (§8.11.3).
L10: Video Mode Burst (§8.11.4) — verify LP transition in BLLP.
L10: Video Mode pixel formats — host implements all four (0x0E/0x1E/0x2E/0x3E); peripheral implements at least one.
L10: Command Mode DCS: 0x05 / 0x15 / 0x06 / 0x39 / 0x21 / 0x22 / 0x1C.
L10: Generic Short/Long: 0x03/0x13/0x23/0x04/0x14/0x24/0x29 + 0x11/0x12/0x1A.
L10: Sync Event packets: 0x01 / 0x11 / 0x21 / 0x31.
L10: Display control: 0x02 / 0x12 / 0x22 / 0x32 / 0x37.
L10: Null Packet (0x09) and Blanking Packet (0x19).
L10: BTA flow: host TurnRequest → BTA → peripheral takes bus → response → peripheral BTA → host.
L10: Acknowledge Trigger Message: peripheral sends single byte 0x21 after non-Read no-error.
L10: Acknowledge and Error Report (DT=0x02 reverse): all 16 bits map to correct conditions.
L10: Error accumulation + clearing: errors accumulate until BTA; cleared on report.
L10: Multi-bit ECC on any command: peripheral sends ONLY Acknowledge and Error Report (no read data).
L10: Single-bit ECC on Read: peripheral sends Read Response + Acknowledge and Error Report in same LP transmission.
L10: Tearing Effect: BTA-without-command → peripheral LP Escape trigger byte 0x5D → BTA back.
L10: Set Maximum Return Packet Size default = 1 at power-on.
L10: Contention recovery (Annex A): Cases 1 / 2 / 3.
L10: Required timers: HRX_TO, HTX_TO, LTX-P_TO, LRX-H_TO; verify LRX-H_TO > LTX-P_TO.
L10: Reserved DT codes (DT[3:0] = 0b0000 or 0b1111) shall NOT be used.
L10: Endian: LSB-first within byte; multi-byte fields LS byte first.
L10: Display Resolution interoperability per Table 23.
L10: Power-up T_INIT sequencing per §5.7.
L16: Exactly 1 Clock Lane + 1..4 Data Lane pairs.
L16: Clock Lane SHALL be driven only by host; peripheral SHALL NOT drive Clock Lane.
L16: All DSI transmitters and receivers SHALL support Continuous Clock behavior.
L16: In Command Mode systems Data Lane 0 SHALL be bidirectional; additional Lanes SHALL be unidirectional.
L16: Forward LP transmissions SHALL use Data Lane 0 only.
L16: Reverse-direction transmissions SHALL use LP mode only on Data Lane 0 only.
L16: Short Packets SHALL be 4 bytes; Long Packets SHALL be 6..65541 bytes.
L16: Packet Header SHALL be 32 bits (DI + WC LS + WC MS + ECC).
L16: Header ECC SHALL be Hamming-modified (24,8) — single-bit correct + 2-bit detect.
L16: P6 and P7 of ECC byte SHALL be 0 by transmitter; receiver SHALL ignore and force to 0.
L16: Long Packet Footer SHALL be CRC-16 poly x^16+x^12+x^5+1, init 0xFFFF, LSB-first, payload only.
L16: Zero-byte payload Footer SHALL be 0xFFFF.
L16: Non-checksum peripheral SHALL transmit 0x0000 in Footer.
L16: Bytes SHALL be LSB-first within byte; multi-byte fields LS byte first.
L16: Devices SHALL support EoTp Short Packet (DT=0x08, payload 0x0F0F, ECC 0x01).
L16: Devices SHALL provide implementation-specific means to enable/disable EoTp.
L16: EoTp SHOULD NOT be sent in LP mode.
L16: Trigger Message byte 0x5D is RESERVED for TE only.
L16: Set Maximum Return Packet Size default SHALL be 1 at power-on / reset.
L16: Set Maximum Return Packet Size SHALL be ignored by unidirectional DSI peripherals.
L16: Host SHALL implement ECC and Checksum capabilities; separately enable/disable.
L16: Peripheral SHALL implement ECC; Checksum implementation is optional.
L16: Bidirectional peripheral SHALL implement HRX_TO and LTX-P_TO.
L16: Host SHALL implement HTX_TO and LRX-H_TO.
L16: LRX-H_TO MUST be set longer than LTX-P_TO.
L16: Host LP clock SHALL be 67%..150% of peripheral LP clock.
L16: Host T_INIT_MASTER SHALL be ≥ t_POR + T_INIT_SLAVE + T_INTERNAL_DELAY.
L16: Peripheral SHALL power up in RX-Stop and SHALL ignore all Link states until T_INIT_SLAVE elapses.
L16: After every BTA peripheral SHALL respond with appropriate packets and return bus.
L16: Errors SHALL accumulate until reported via Acknowledge and Error Report, then clear.
L16: Bit 7 and Bit 14 of Error Report SHALL be transmitted as 0.
L16: Video Mode peripheral SHALL implement at least one of the four pixel formats; host SHALL implement all four.
L16: Host SHALL implement one or more Display Resolutions in Table 23.
L16: DT codes with DT[3:0] = 0b0000 or 0b1111 SHALL NOT be used.
L16: Multi-Lane implementations SHALL use a single common Clock Lane shared by all Data Lanes.
